name: Nikon Corporation
summary: Nikon Corporation manufactures and sells optical instruments in Japan, North America, Europe, China, Thailand, and internationally. It operates through Imaging Business, Precision Equipment Business, Healthcare Business, Components Business, and Digital Manufacturing Business segments. The Imaging Business segment provides interchangeable-lens and integrated-lens digital cameras, digital cinema cameras, and others. The Precision Equipment Business segment offers FPD exposure equipment. The Healthcare Business segment provides products and services for the life science solutions field, such as biological microscopes and cell culture observation equipment.
